reason_reconstruction: The write-once authorization correctly recorded the owner-approved attempt limits under owner_approval, but the reviewed executor expects a top-level attempts object with maximum=2 and seconds_each=10800. The top-level object was absent. The executor refused before arming the AWS deadline or making any mutation.

receipt_diagnostic_limitation.cause: The runner was invoked by file path, loading its OperationRefusal class once as __main__ and once through scripts.asr_base_model_pilot_runner; the safe-reason isinstance check therefore lost the typed reason.
receipt_diagnostic_limitation.evidence_basis_for_reconstructed_reason: Read-only evaluation of every branch in deadline_identity_and_acceptance against the bound authorization, packet, bindings, caller, time and reviewed worktree state identified the missing top-level attempts object as the first failing predicate.

required_successor.authorization: Create a new write-once successor authorization containing the executor-required top-level attempts representation; do not edit ASR-BASE-MODEL-AWS-AUTH-2026-002.
required_successor.invocation: Invoke the runner as a module so the exception class has one identity and keep environment dependencies outside the reviewed worktree so git cleanliness remains exact.
required_successor.tests: Add local regression coverage for authorization schema compatibility, typed refusal retention and a clean reviewed worktree.
required_successor.approval: Independent review and explicit owner direction are required before using the one remaining numbered attempt.

secondary_preflight_finding.finding: The temporary .venv symlink used to reach the shared dependency environment was untracked inside the detached reviewed worktree.
secondary_preflight_finding.correction: Remove the symlink and invoke the external virtual-environment interpreter with PYTHONPATH set to the reviewed worktree; no dependency artifact may be created inside the reviewed tree.
